subject: learning/parallel-memory-resolve
statement: The shared historical-transition check refuses insertion that makes an unchanged rejected or dangling historical act effective.
intent: Replace repository-wide chronological exclusion with a precise guard against retrospective effects.
rationale: The check compares exact retained carrier paths and bytes and actual honored relation maps, not just disappearing diagnostics. Revoked carriers do not act; dangling supersession still needs protection when its carrier is superseded because its transitive effect can survive. Missing projections fail closed and violations have deterministic ordering.
